stops.note: compound of san ("return"), ko ("go"), and fa ("fetch"), from the proverb about retrieving what was left behind
taken up in African-American and pan-African discourse as a symbol for reclaiming heritage, boosted by the 1993 film of the same name
stops.meaning: the principle of learning from the past to move forward

current_meaning: the Akan principle, symbolized by a backward-looking bird, of retrieving wisdom from the past to build the future
